newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps lifts TNP Enterprises rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps lifts TNP Enterprises rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it raised its rating for the secured debentures of TNP Enterprises Inc, the parent of Texas-New Mexico Power Co, to double-B-minus from single-B-plus.
The credit rating agency also reaffirmed TNP's first mortgage bonds at double-B, affecting $270 million of debt.
The upgrade is based on the company's improving cash flow and progress toward strengthening its financial position, Duff & Phelps said.
TNP provides electric service to 85 small communities in Texas and New Mexico.
Its shares were off 7/8 Wednesday at 20.
